title: sbx/pi-kit
summary: Docker Hub 官方 overview 将 sbx/pi-kit 定义为 @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent 的独立 Docker Sandbox kit，记录 pre-baked image、TUI 入口、Anthropic proxy-managed 凭据、network allowlist、Pi auth 优先级和可复现的 PI_VERSION 构建参数。
why_useful: 这是带官方项目说明的 Pi Sandbox kit，能具体观察容器化 Pi 的凭据隔离、网络策略、可复现版本和首次启动取舍。
discovery_backend: official Docker Hub public repository search API exact pi kit alias
readback_backend: official Docker Hub repository detail and full overview APIs (anonymous read-only)
limitations: Hub 的 kit artifact latest tag 没有 image manifest（tag images 为空）；构建与端到端行为未执行，overview 的安全和认证描述仍需源码/测试审计。
readback_evidence: Official Hub detail HTTP 200 on 2026-08-29; public repository registered 2026-08-13. Full overview explicitly names @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent, `sbx run --kit docker.io/sbx/pi-kit:latest pi`, pre-baked image, proxy-managed API/OAuth credential handling, network allowlist, auth precedence and `--build-arg PI_VERSION=<version>` reproducibility. Detail description is ‘Minimal terminal coding agent with extensible tools, skills, and TUI’. Latest tag endpoint HTTP 200 but images array is empty because this object is an OCI kit artifact; no image pull/run or account interaction.

title: sbx/pi-image
summary: Docker Hub 官方 overview 将 sbx/pi-image 定义为 Pi kit 的基础镜像，明确记录 Node 22.22.1、fd-find、全局 @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent、非 root agent 用户、Pi 入口和对应 sbx/pi-kit 关系；latest 提供 amd64 与 arm64 manifests。
why_useful: 它把 Pi kit 的运行时基础层单独公开，适合审查架构支持、工具探测、非 root 执行和 npm latest 夜间重建策略。
discovery_backend: official Docker Hub public repository search API exact pi image alias
readback_backend: official Docker Hub repository detail, full overview, latest tag and manifest-history APIs (anonymous read-only)
limitations: latest tracks npm latest and is mutable；未拉取或运行镜像，Node/base-image 与 Pi 版本未做独立重建，overview 不是安全保证。
readback_evidence: Official Hub detail/full overview HTTP 200 on 2026-08-29; public repository registered 2026-08-24. Overview names @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent, Node 22.22.1 requirement, fd symlink, non-root agent, CMD ["pi"] and sbx/pi-kit. Latest tag HTTP 200 exposes amd64 digest sha256:a78f2b2fd4263664914ec709d0ff33105b6f08a1ab3237254ba51ba351c1e927 and arm64 digest sha256:3b3967e945d9f427c56107a9334df4c58d94f780f4ca2156450aa1f308ec9e5b; manifest-history HTTP 200 exposes npm metadata fetch, Pi install layer, labels, WORKDIR /home/agent and CMD ["pi"]. No login, pull, run, push or account interaction.
